question: Where can I get a list of drinking water treatment plants in Spain, with location, capacity and operator?

answer.summary: No public national list of drinking water treatment plants (ETAP) with location, capacity and operator exists. The national registry (SINAC, 2,625 ETAP in 2024) is restricted to professional users. Public pieces: EIEL (rows per treatment, not plant, small municipalities, no name or capacity), Andalucía DERA WFS (870 points) and Madrid WFS (14 plants with capacity, Canal de Isabel II), Navarra (2 plants), plus operator pages (MCT, Aigües de Barcelona).
main_caveats: EIEL rows are potabilization treatments, not plants: in Asturias 2024, 1,106 of 1,111 rows are disinfection-only; ORGANISMO is the quality-control body, not the operator.
EIEL excludes municipalities of 50,000 or more and País Vasco and Navarra; in the 2024 download only 15 of 52 provinces have rows.
Capacity units differ or are missing (Madrid NM_CAPACIDAD is m3/day by inference, Navarra none, MCT m³/seg, Aigües de Barcelona l/s).
The Andalucía layer named ETAP includes 364 deposits and 333 chlorination points among 870 features; last update 2022-02-02.
Catalonia (more than 250 ETAP, three operators), Valencia, Galicia, Canarias and País Vasco have no ETAP layer found; regional portals were not each opened.
answer.confidence_reason: Negatives rest on opened ministry, IDE and open-data pages; SINAC content is unseen, OSM operator counts failed and several regional portals were only probed by catalogue search.

attributes.note: Points for Andalucía, Madrid, Navarra, Pontevedra, Badajoz, EIEL where the layer has them, and OSM; Catalonia, Valencia, Galicia, País Vasco: none found.
attributes.gap_note: No ETAP layer found for the other regions in IDEE CODSI, datos.gob.es titles, ACA/Catalan open data and web searches; region portals not each opened (see leads).

attributes.note: Madrid 14 plants, Navarra 2 (no unit), MCT 3 of 6, Aigües de Barcelona 3 in prose. EIEL, DERA and SINAC public pages have none.
attributes.gap_note: No capacity in EIEL dictionary, DERA layer, SINAC public pages or annual report; other operators' pages not all opened.

attributes.note: Madrid (Canal de Isabel II, from metadata), Navarra TITULAR, MCT and Aigües de Barcelona; EIEL gives only the control body; Catalonia names 3 operators.
attributes.gap_note: SINAC holds the operator per infrastructure but only for professional users; no public per-plant operator list elsewhere.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL -G 'https://eiel.redsara.es/descargas/descargar-fichero' --data-urlencode 'periodo=2024' --data-urlencode 'cuadro=Todos los cuadros' --data-urlencode 'provincia=41' --data-urlencode 'isla=Seleccionar' --data-urlencode 'municipio=Seleccionar' --data-urlencode 'nivel=P' -o 2024_41.zip ; for points: curl -sL 'https://eiel.redsara.es/visor/layer-json/fase:2024-codine:33/capa:TP'
how_to_use.example_result: The outer zip holds 2024_41.zip, which holds 2024_POTABILIZACION_ENC_41.txt (127 lines), e.g. '2024|TP|41|001|001|AU|CD|SI|NO|NO|NO|NO|NO|HP|NO|NO|QU|MA|B'. Layer JSON for Asturias (33): {"geom_id":"1613930","geom_key":"2024-TP-33-055-008","geom":"{\"type\":\"MultiPoint\",\"coordinates\":[[-4.5265,43.3747]]}"} (1,080 points for 1,111 rows).
steps: GET https://eiel.redsara.es/descargas/recargar-formulario-inicial?periodo=YYYY returns JSON with the provinces (id 01..52) and the cuadros; cuadro 18 = POTABILIZACION_ENC, 17 = TRAT_POTA_NUCLEO, 19 = POTABILIZACION_ENC_M50.

GET /descargas/descargar-fichero with periodo, cuadro='Todos los cuadros', provincia, isla='Seleccionar', municipio='Seleccionar', nivel=P returns a zip that contains a zip per phase; open the inner one and read YYYY_POTABILIZACION_ENC_NN.txt (latin1, '|' separator, decimal comma, no header row, 19 fields in the order of key_fields).

For points call /visor/layer-json/fase:YYYY-codine:NN/capa:TP (the call the geoEIEL viewer makes; the layer id TP comes from /visor/getDefaultThemes). Join on geom_key = fase-TP-prov-mun-orden, zero-padded.
To keep rows that look like plants, drop rows with S_DESINF=SI that have no CAT_A1/A2/A3, DESALADORA or OTROS flag.
Repeat per province and keep the latest phase that has rows; there is no national file.
reading_traps: A row is a treatment, not an ETAP: in Asturias 2024, 1,106 of 1,111 rows are disinfection-only (S_DESINF=SI), 1,031 are in deposits and only 7 have CAT_A2 or CAT_A3.
The table has no plant name and no capacity or flow field. ORGANISMO is the body that does the quality control, not the operator or owner; ESTADO is state of conservation, not in-service status.

Coverage is uneven: in the 2024 download 15 of 52 provinces have rows (5,405 in total), 25 return an empty file and 12 (e.g. Albacete, Alicante, Badajoz, Córdoba, Granada, Murcia) have no POTABILIZACION_ENC file in the 2024 zip; Pontevedra has 226 rows in 2022 but 0 in 2024 and 2025.

Points are missing for many rows: Sevilla 2024 has 127 rows and the layer returns an empty list; Asturias has 1,080 points for 1,111 rows. The viewer link /export_shp/TP/2024/33 returned a shapefile with every point at (1,0) and no .prj: use the JSON layer.
A request for a year with several phases (2023 for Pontevedra) returned a 14 MB zip with older phases inside, and file names repeat the province code. País Vasco and Navarra are not in the survey.

problems: The ministry sede pages sede.administracionespublicas.gob.es/ayuda/consulta/EIEL and /EIELDescargas returned HTTP 503 (Ha ocurrido un error, vuelva a intentarlo más tarde) on three tries; eiel.redsara.es works.
The viewer shapefile export is corrupt (all points at 1,0).

regulator.name: Ministerio de Sanidad (SINAC, Dirección General de Salud Pública), with autonomous health authorities; MITECO Dirección General del Agua for the hydrological side

operators.note: Municipalities, mancomunidades, public companies (Canal de Isabel II, ATL, MCT) and private concessions (Aigües de Barcelona, Taigua); ACA says Catalonia has more than 250 ETAP run by three operators plus municipalities. No public census found.

publication_obligation.norm: Real Decreto 3/2023, art. 62 and Annex XI
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Operators must enter their infrastructures (including ETAP) in SINAC and review them yearly; the Ministry publishes an annual national report and summarised online information per supply zone, not a plant list.
publication_obligation.frequency: Infrastructure data reviewed annually; national report annual.

consolidated_republication.note: The Ministry republishes aggregates; EIEL reunites only small municipalities; no body reunites plant-level data publicly.

recipe: Start from the EIEL or DERA point (source 1 or 2) or from SINAC totals to know which municipality has a plant.

For each large plant find its operator (ACA page for Catalonia, MCT pages for the Segura basin, Canal de Isabel II table for Madrid) and read the capacity sentence on the operator page or in its annual report, as done for Sant Joan Despí (5.300 l/s), Sierra de la Espada (2,125 m³/seg.) and Madrid (14 rows).
Normalise units to m3/day (1 l/s = 86.4 m3/day; 1 m3/s = 86,400 m3/day) and write the unit and source next to each figure.
Check each figure against a second document when available (the Madrid WFS and the operator page agree except Majadahonda 328,000 vs 328.300 and printed unit errors).
if_unstructured.location_method: Use the EIEL/DERA/IDEM/IDENA points where they exist; otherwise use the municipality named in the operator page or the viability report and locate the plant on the PNOA orthophoto (WMS https://www.ign.es/wms-inspire/pnoa-ma) and the cadastre WMS; precision then is parcel level only if checked on the image.
cross_with: EIEL POTABILIZACION_ENC key (fase-TP-province-municipality-order) with geoEIEL layer TP
SINAC counts in the annual report (2,625 ETAP) to judge completeness
MITECO Unidades de demanda urbana PHC 2022-2027 and Zonas protegidas aguas potables for source water context

where_published.name: Operator pages and annual reports
where_published.what: Per-plant description with capacity, year and treatment train (MCT); investment plans and annual reports with capacities (Aigües de Barcelona); table of 14 plants (Canal de Isabel II).
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Open the operator site, find 'Instalaciones' or 'Potabilizadoras' pages; for PDFs run pdftotext and search 'capacitat', 'capacidad', 'l/s', 'm3/s'; no site search was used.

example_document.what_it_gives: Page text: "L'Etap de Sant Joan Despí és una infraestructura de captació i tractament d'aigua del riu Llobregat ... La seva capacitat màxima és de 5.300 l/s." and "Increment de la capacitat d'extracció a l'Etap Besòs fins a 1,14 m3/s" (project list).

where_published.name: Agència Catalana de l'Aigua, Estacions de potabilització d'aigua
where_published.what: States the number of ETAP in Catalonia, the operators and the competence, with a PDF map of the Ter-Llobregat plants.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Static page; follow the links to ATL, Aigües de Barcelona and Taigua plant pages.

example_document.what_it_gives: "Al territori català hi ha més de 250 estacions de tractament d’aigua potable (ETAP), 6 de les quals formen part de la Xarxa bàsica d’abastament Ter-Llobregat. Tres operadores diferents exploten aquestes plantes"

where_published.name: MITECO informes de viabilidad de obras hidráulicas
where_published.what: Project reports for works in ETAP of state bodies (Confederaciones, MCT); name the plant and municipality, give budgets, rarely capacity.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Browse the MITECO page by basin or operator folder; search the PDF text for 'ETAP'.

example_document.what_it_gives: Page 7: "Las actuaciones se ubican por completo en el interior de la parcela que ocupa la ETAP Salteras, localizada al noroeste del término municipal de Salteras, en la provincia de Sevilla." Budget 1.955.954,55 EUR; no capacity (reports for La Pedrera and Sierra de la Espada also gave no capacity).

open_questions: Whether the SINAC citizen view lists ETAP per supply zone cannot be settled here: it needs a form submission, which the research rules exclude.
Whether the MCT SIG viewer or the SINAC professional access hold capacity and operator for all plants needs a request to those bodies.

history.note: No public national ETAP list; best is EIEL (no name or capacity) plus regional layers (Andalucía, Madrid, Navarra) and operator pages; SINAC registry is restricted.
